components.basis: Language: the {neg,to}-fragment of Fm_CPL, formed from propositional variables by neg and to alone (sheet line 7; setting lines 35-38; definition line 15), with the full language reached only through the announced translation tr_H. Axiom schemas A1-A3 and MP displayed (sheet lines 8-11; restated w02b body lines 90-95). Assumption convention: a Hilbert derivation from Gamma is a finite sequence each member of which is in Gamma, a uniform-substitution instance of a schema, or follows from two earlier members by MP (definition lines 15-21; w02b body lines 95-97: a member of Gamma may be written at any line; MP is the only rule, with no side condition).

evidence.label: sheet:hilbert-cpl (Deduction theorem paragraph; premise-sensitivity remark lines 25-27)

components.basis: Statement for every set Gamma (no finiteness restriction) and all phi, psi of the fragment: Gamma u {phi} derives psi iff Gamma derives (phi -> psi). Written proof: right-to-left by one MP step after adding phi; left-to-right by induction over the lines of a derivation from Gamma u {phi}, with the member-of-Gamma/axiom case (A1 + MP), the theta_i = phi case (explicit A1, A1, A2 instances and two MP steps for phi -> phi), and the MP case (A2 instance and two MP steps), noting these exhaust the line licences. Premise scope is stated exactly and the sheet records why the theorem holds for this premise-sensitive calculus (only rule MP; uniform substitution instantiates schemas, not assumptions).

components.gap: Both-direction translations/equivalence with the selected ND presentation are not supplied in complete form. The ND-to-Hilbert map thm:p02-w02b-p02-010-nd-to-hilbert, and with it the ND-Hilbert and LK-Hilbert legs thm:p02-w02b-p02-010-hilbert-equivalence(1)-(2) on which the Hilbert leg of thm:p02-calculi-derivability-equivalence rests (annex/p02/propositional-hilbert.tex:53-63), are defined and proved only for ND derivations in which every discharge 'applies to all open occurrences of its formula' (parts/p02/axiomatic-calculi-analytic-tableaux-and-refutation-w02b-p02-010.tex:46-55), and the proof's discharge cases rest on the claim that 'the sheet discharges every open occurrence of the discharged formula' (annex/p02/axiomatic-calculi-analytic-tableaux-and-refutation-w02b-p02-010.tex:448-452). The selected ND presentation discharges exactly the open occurrences marked with the application's label, which 'may be some but not all of the open occurrences' (registry/calculi/nd-cpl.tex:16 and rows 23, 24, 26, 29; restoration/inherited-02193-02340.tex:14-21). No written step translates derivations with such discharges into Hilbert derivations or proves that the full-discharge derivability relation coincides with Gamma derives_ND_CPL phi of the selected presentation. The LK-to-Hilbert map inherits the gap: it feeds the sheet:nd-fol tree built in annex:p7.calculi.3 (label-based discharge, registry/calculi/nd-fol.tex:17-22) into the full-discharge ND-to-Hilbert construction and asserts without proof that the tree is an ND_CPL derivation in that sense (annex .../w02b-p02-010.tex:604-613). Owed: the ND-to-Hilbert translation, and hence the ND-Hilbert and LK-Hilbert equivalences, for every derivation of the selected ND presentation with label-based (possibly partial) discharge, in written steps, with the setting convention made to match that presentation. The Hilbert-to-ND and Hilbert-to-LK maps, the LK and ND explicit comparison (tab:p02-proof-systems, fig:p02-nd-lk-correspondence, size and proof-shape limits, relations) are present.
